{{Quote|Brothers, sisters... back to the ''temple''. The forest pool will obviously not be ''fit'' for our dawn meditation.|Brother of the Sacred Circle|<ref name="MSW36" />}}
'''Meditation Grove''' was a clearing within the rain forest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]], near the [[Temple of the Sacred Circle]]. Priests of the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]] would frequently meditate before the calm pool in the center of the glade. [[Saber cat]]s were treated as pets by the priests, and allowed to roam the grove freely. During the [[Mission to Monastery]] a misunderstanding led [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to kill a saber cat, believing it to be threatening [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]].<ref name="MSW36" />
